_meta.description: Chef subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: heal power, burn DoT, HP sustain.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la puissance de soin de 1% et la durée des buffs de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases heal power by 1% and buff duration by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les dégâts de 1% et la MAG de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage by 1% and MAG by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les PV max de 0.8% et les soins reçus de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases max HP by 0.8% and healing received by 0.5% per level.
